addresses.name: CEffect::GetBlockText
addresses.signature: Hoi3CString* __thiscall CEffect::GetBlockText(CEffect* this, Hoi3CString* out, CEventScope* scope, int depth, Hoi3CString group, int unknown)
addresses.comment: **Slot 8: an effect block as the tooltip shows it.** 0x59C710 to the single `ret 0x2C` at 0x59CB0E. I = three spaces (0x11F39A8) depth times. T = its own slot 9 (a copy of group, the trailing int). R = ''; **only where T is longer than one character** R = I + T. Then for each child c, with n the next: L = c.slot10(scope) is asked of every child; where n exists, c.slot6() == n.slot6() and L is not empty, G += L + '§W,§Y ' (0x11F39AC) and nothing is written for c; otherwise R += **I** + c.slot8(scope, depth, G, the trailing int) and G is emptied. out = R. So a run of one keyword becomes one line written by its last member, which reads the earlier labels out of `group` (CAddCoreEffect, CRemCoreEffect - the only labels); and **a child's block is prefixed with its parent's indent as well as its own**, so a leaf line at depth d carries 2d indents (6d spaces). Options, the `immediate` block and decisions ask at depth 0 (CEventOption::GetEffectsText, DecisionEffectsText), where nothing is indented; only CContextEffect and CRegionScopeEffect raise the depth. 87 of the 101 family tables hold this body; the 14 that override it are the scope and iteration effects (`any_*`, `random_*`, `random`, `random_list`, `region`, CContextEffect), and those call this body on themselves rather than through the slot. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-scripttext.md.
